note: Both sets capture the nine drivetrain properties in Table 5-1 with correct values, units, bindings and supporting quotes, and both keep the fully-deployed condition on the brake torque. Set B, however, states the 12.1 rpm rated rotor speed twice — once as 'Rated Rotor Speed' and once as 'Rated Speed' under Rotor — a pure duplicate of the same fact. Set A is otherwise identical in content, so it is the cleaner and equally complete set.
remarks: Both sets omit the gearbox assumption of no frictional losses and the 5% critical structural-damping ratio of the driveshaft (free-free mode, rigid generator and rotor) stated in the prose; these are secondary but real facts on the page. The prose also notes the 0.6 s is a time lag for full engagement with a linear ramp in FAST/ADAMS, which neither set captures as a condition on the time constant.
